basic_info.name: SLAP / SLAP v2 — two distinct models sharing the name: (1) 'SLAP: Siamese Language-Audio Pretraining Without Negative Samples for Music Understanding' (Guinot et al., QMUL/UMG/Telecom-Paris, ISMIR 2025); (2) 'SLAP: Scalable Language-Audio Pretraining with Variable-Duration Audio and Multi-Objective Training' (Mei et al., Meta, ICASSP 2026, arXiv 2601.12594). NOTE: research summary conflated them — the 'v2' (109M pairs, variable duration) paper is the Meta model, NOT a v2 of the Siamese BYOL SLAP
basic_info.org: (1) Queen Mary University of London + Universal Music Group + Telecom-Paris (Julien Guinot, Alain Riou, Elio Quinton, Gyorgy Fazekas, funded by EPSRC CDT in AI & Music and UMG); (2) Meta (Xinhao Mei, Gael Le Lan, Haohe Liu, Zhaoheng Ni, Varun Nagaraja, Yang Liu, Yangyang Shi, Vikas Chandra)
basic_info.release_date: (1) arXiv 21 Jun 2025, accepted ISMIR 2025; (2) arXiv 18 Jan 2026, accepted ICASSP 2026 (Barcelona, May 2026)
basic_info.links: (1) paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.17815 ; code: https://github.com/Pliploop/SLAP (training/eval code; no official pretrained checkpoints found [uncertain]); (2) paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.12594 ; no code/checkpoint repo found [uncertain]

architecture.backbone: (1) Same stack as LAION-CLAP: HTS-AT audio transformer + RoBERTa-base text encoder, plus a ReLU MLP predictor (one 4096-wide hidden layer) and EMA target encoders for both modalities; total 193M params. (2) Redesigned Transformer-based audio encoder trained from scratch with 2D Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) and alternating attention, natively supporting variable-duration inputs up to 30 s via sequence packing + Flash Attention; text encoder and model size not verified [uncertain]
architecture.input_modality: audio (music) + text (English captions); (2) general audio in principle, evaluated mostly on general audio-text benchmarks
architecture.training_objective: (1) BYOL-style, negative-free: four cosine-distance losses — intermodal (audio query->text EMA target, text query->audio EMA target) plus intramodal losses (query vs EMA target within each modality), lambda-balanced; collapse prevented by EMA target encoders ( tau=0.95 ) and per-modality predictors; SpecAugment audio augmentation; usable at inference via either predictions q or projections z (projections slightly worse). (2) Contrastive + additional self-supervised loss + captioning loss unified in single-stage multi-objective training
architecture.embedding_output: (1) 512-dim projection & prediction embeddings (global, attention-pooled via HTS-AT/CLAP-style projection head), frame-level support available from the HTS-AT encoder [uncertain]. (2) embedding dim not verified [uncertain]; paper mentions dense representations for fine-grained tasks, suggesting frame-level features exist [uncertain]

data.training_data: (1) PrivateCaps: 260,000 pairs of full-length production-quality music tracks with professionally annotated captions (private, UMG-internal, not publicly available / license unknown). (2) MovieGen Audio pretraining set: ~109M audio-text pairs of variable duration with captioning-model-generated captions, an order of magnitude larger than previous CLAP sets; dataset not publicly available, but curation pipeline is described

performance.benchmarks: (1, embedding-family, text-music retrieval) Song Describer (pretrained init): A->T R@1 5.7 / R@5 18.1 / R@10 26.6; T->A R@1 6.0 / R@5 18.1 / R@10 26.4. MusicCaps (pretrained init): A->T R@1 3.1 / R@5 10.1 / R@10 15.4; T->A R@1 3.0. Zero-shot: GTZAN acc 58.3; MTAT AUROC 75.0, mAP 31.5; OpenMic mAR 70.5. Linear probing: GTZAN 82.9, MTAT mAP 45.8 (SOTA vs prior 41.1), OpenMic mAP 86.2. (2, embedding-family, general audio-text retrieval, fine-tuned on AudioCaps/Clotho): AudioCaps R@1 47.5 (T->A), 63.4 (A->T); Clotho R@1 27.2 (T->A), 36.8 (A->T) — claimed new SOTA; variable-duration handling helps on longer clips (Clotho 15-30 s)
performance.vs_clap: (1) beats same-architecture CLAP baseline trained on identical existing data across all Song Describer/MusicCaps retrieval metrics (e.g. Song Describer R@10: 26.6 vs 22.2 A->T), beats reproduced CLAP zero-shot GTZAN (58.3 vs 51.7), and outperforms MusCALL and LAION-CLAP on Song Describer (LAION-CLAP wins MusicCaps only because its training data includes AudioSet, the source of MusicCaps audio). (2) reported as state-of-the-art vs previous CLAP models on audio-text retrieval and zero-shot classification; exact deltas vs LAION-CLAP not extracted [uncertain]

availability.license: (1) code repo: README badge says MIT but license section says GNUv3 — contradictory [uncertain]; training data private; no released checkpoints [uncertain]. (2) arXiv paper is CC-BY-NC-ND 4.0; no public checkpoints/code found, production use likely gated on Meta [uncertain]

fit_for_local_playlist.sample_rate: (1) HTS-AT convention 16 kHz mel-spectrograms [uncertain]; (2) not verified [uncertain] — both would require resampling from repo-standard 48k mono
fit_for_local_playlist.inference_cost: (1) 193M params, single forward per clip, runs on CPU with reasonable latency and ~1 GB memory [uncertain]; training (not needed locally) used 6 x A100. (2) model size unknown [uncertain]; trained from scratch at Meta scale
fit_for_local_playlist.full_track_context: (1) trained on full-length tracks (PrivateCaps) but HTS-AT encoder only accepts a fixed-size input window; long tracks need windowed inference + aggregation [uncertain]. (2) natively supports variable-duration clips up to 30 s with sequence packing; tracks longer than 30 s need windowing [uncertain]
fit_for_local_playlist.frame_level_support: (1) HTS-AT yields token/frame-level representations for probing; the joint embedding itself is global only; explicit frame-level music-text alignment not provided. (2) paper explicitly motivates multiple objectives to learn 'richer dense audio representations', suggesting dense/frame features, but no specified frame-level API [uncertain]
fit_for_local_playlist.retrieval_steering: No explicit attribute-control mechanism; (1) BYOL formulation yields projections z and predictions q, giving two usable embedding spaces per modality (mild steering option), plus near-zero modality gap which helps likelihood/steering usage [uncertain]
